content.short: Vaca Ninja is a Cardano play-to-earn platform game using NFT characters, stages, and player rewards.
content.description: Vaca Ninja - Infinity Worlds is a Cardano game where players compete in purpose-built mini-games called stages. Players can use default ninja characters or NFT characters with stronger powers, weapons, and stamina to improve their results. Community builders, called architects, can create stages with the StageBuilder tool, expanding the game world beyond a fixed set of levels. The project combines collectible NFT characters, competitive rankings, and reward mechanics inside a playful Cardano gaming universe.
content.meta: Vaca Ninja - Infinity Worlds is a platform game where players pay to play in order to accrue rewards. Explore Vaca Ninja on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
